notes: metrics are fractions in [0,1]; every diff is name minus reference
mean/sd_seed/sd_fold/sd_all and diff_vs_uniform use per-seed CV means (mean of 5 fold values)

bootstrap diffs, CIs and p-values refer to pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 averaged over seeds; p_boot = 0 means below 2/n_boot, so p_holm = 0 means below m*2/n_boot for a family of m; replicates with zero difference count towards both tails (conservative for near-identical rules)
primary_analysis (pre-specified): SA-WSV (bootstrap) - uniform, Holm over the 3 corpora; secondary_analysis: SA-WSV w/o confidence - uniform, its own Holm over the 3 corpora

the two-stage bootstrap conditions on the CV partition and on each fold's validation split, which all seeds share (rule weights see one validation sample per fold; rev_robustness.py refits on validation subsamples); resampling S seeds understates the between-seed variance by (S-1)/S: seed_inflated scales the resampled seeds' deviations by sqrt(S/(S-1)); seed_t_interval is a t-interval over the S per-seed pooled differences (seed variability only, conditional on the test set)
equiv_<delta>: 90% CI inside (-delta, +delta), i.e. TOST at 5% per side, not multiplicity-corrected

Holm families within corpus and reference: p_holm = all other names, learners included (the specified family); p_holm_rules = the other rules only (null for learners); McNemar: all other names, within seed
McNemar b = name (or monolingual learner) right and reference (or multilingual learner) wrong, c = reverse

band: per_seed and worst_seed_* are single-run values on per-seed CV means; max_abs_diff_vs_uniform, argmax, signed_diff and range_incl_uniform are seed-averaged, which shrinks run-to-run differences; band_claim is the submission's 'within 0.8 points'; genuine_soft_votes = all soft rules except not_genuine_soft_votes; original_soft_rules = the submission's ten soft-voting rules without uniform
m_eff = participation ratio (tr R)^2/tr(R^2) of the correctness correlations (effective dimensionality); n_eff_variance = M/(1+(M-1)*rho_mean), the variance-equivalent number of independent voters
seeds are read once at start-up; meta.warnings lists incomplete seeds, differing seed sets and dropped names; --strict refuses to run with any of them

pools: rules refitted on the pool's validation posteriors; results are descriptive: descriptive: test instances resampled within folds (boot_vs_single_seed also resamples the single-seed side's seeds); conditional on the fine-tuning runs pooled, hence no p-values or equivalence flags

primary_analysis.quantity: pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 averaged over seeds (as significance.point_pooled_f1)
primary_analysis.test: two-sided two-stage bootstrap p (seeds and test instances within folds), Holm over corpora

secondary_analysis.comparison: SA-WSV w/o confidence - Uniform soft voting
secondary_analysis.quantity: pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 averaged over seeds (as significance.point_pooled_f1)
secondary_analysis.test: two-sided two-stage bootstrap p (seeds and test instances within folds), Holm over corpora
